text:
sophia: Quick sync on the latency-vs-cost playbook for the launch. Goal: one hero chart + one tactical slide for sales routing + a short form for inbound TCO requests. Keep everything skimmable for PMs and SDRs.

tom: Sounds good. For the hero chart, I'm thinking a quadrant layout (fast/expensive, fast/cheap, slow/cheap, slow/expensive) but with an overlay that shows the effect of "Optimize" actions (batching, caching, quant). Helps non-technical readers see "how to move".

ana: Quadrant is nice, but can we avoid generic labels? propose: "Real-time (sub-100ms)", "Near-real-time (100-500ms)", "Background (>500ms)" on the x-axis and cost per 1k tokens on y-axis. Add small icons for Hosted/Dedicated/Private in each quadrant.

devon: +1 to the icons. Also want a microcase example in the slide: "Customer X: 250k tokens/mo, chat latency target 150ms -> recommended: Dedicated small + batching = est $120/mo". That makes routing easier for SDRs.

sophia: Good. We should avoid dense charts. Hero should be one clean svg, colorblind-friendly palette, and a microtable beside it with 3 sample profiles (startup chatbot, enterprise assistant, compliance search).

tom: Messaging options: short tagline: "Choose your SLA. Control your cost." Longer headline: "From tokens to dollars: practical levers to hit your latency and TCO goals." Which reads better?

ana: Long headline is clearer for a blog. Short tagline is better for social and slide headers. We need both.

devon: For inbound form fields, suggest: "monthly tokens", "latency target (ms)", "sensitivity to P95 vs avg", "industry/compliance". That should route to Hosted trial, Dedicated sizing, or Private contact. Add a checkbox: "Yes, share usage data for a free config".

ops-bot: @devon created intake template: https://forms.redwood/internal/tco-intake. Use slug tco-intake-v1.

devon: Nice. Can ops-bot also add an instruction to auto-tag leads as: trial, sizing, compliance?

ops-bot: @devon rule created: if monthly_tokens < 1e6 AND latency_target >= 300 -> tag: trial. If monthly_tokens >= 1e6 OR latency_target < 200 -> tag: sizing. If industry contains regulated OR compliance checked -> tag: compliance.

sophia: Perf chart ask for design: 1) hero svg (1200x600) 2) microcase png (400x200) 3) slide-ready 16:9 export with sample playbook bullets. Deliver by Wednesday COB.

tom: Design note: avoid log axis; instead show typical token distributions with small inset histogram if needed. Reviewers confuse logs.

ana: Copy for microcases: I'll draft 3 blurbs: Startup Chatbot, B2B Assistant, Regulated Knowledge Search. Each: problem statement, target latency, recommended config, estimated $/k.

devon: Sales playbook (one-liner per bucket): Trial: "Start fast with Hosted; enable prefix cache; upgrade when you scale." Sizing: "Dedicated sizing + reserved pool; enable batching, keep P95 low." Compliance: "Private deployment + KMS; SLA and audit docs ready."

sophia: Add a short line about fallbacks: "Under load we auto-route to a cost-compatible variant to preserve availability" — important for enterprise trust.

tom: Webinar plan: 20-min narrative + 10-min demo + 10-min Q&A. Slides: hero chart, microcase table, routing playbook, demo steps. Need speaker notes for each slide.

ana: I'll draft speaker notes for the hero and microcases. Will also include a 1-slide appendix with the intake form flow and routing logic.

ops-bot: @sophia draft deck skeleton created at https://drive.redwood/marketing/tco-playbook/deck-v1.pptx.

sophia: Thanks. Final asks: design deliverables Wed COB, copy first draft Thu AM, ops to wire intake and tags by Thu EOD, rehearsal Fri. Anyone blocked?

devon: No blockers from Sales.

tom: No blockers. I'll prep the demo scripts.

ana: One quick UX ask: on the intake form, allow "sample payload" paste so we can run matching configs. Ops?

ops-bot: @ana added free-text field 'sample_payload' to tco-intake-v1. Limit 10k chars.

sophia: Great. Closing this thread. I'll post design links and the first draft slide deck in #marketing when ready. :party_popper:
